assertions: job scheduler progress survives service recreation
attempt log cursor returns persisted outbox events
GPU heavy and CPU channels are isolated
retry preserves attempts and idempotent create behavior
job lifecycle is durable across process exit and restart
g5 queue APIs stay bounded and paginated

notes: Used .venv pytest without remote provider/comfy runtime. Covers idempotent job creation/claim/recovery and local-only restart semantics. No production-wide H3 job lane or external network dependency was exercised.
